hero.title: We build trust before we build property
hero.subtitle: At AlResalah Group, we deliver real-estate investments that combine prime locations, refined design, and growing value — because the land of today is the wealth of tomorrow.

about.title: Our new era began — and every decision is built with our clients
about.p1: Since 2008, AlResalah Group has been quietly turning Egyptian land into long-term wealth. From our first plot in Greater Cairo to our latest investments in New Obour City, every decision starts with one question: would we put our own money into this?
about.p2: We are not the loudest developer in Egypt — we are the one your friend recommends after closing a deal. Headquartered on Gesr El-Suez Street in Cairo, our team of advisors, engineers and legal experts walks every plot, audits every contract, and stays with you long after the keys are handed over.
about.philosophy: Land doesn't lose value — bad timing does.
about.pillar1Desc: Every plot we sell, our partners stand on first. No brochure-only deals. No second-hand promises.
about.pillar2Desc: We price land the way smart money buys it — based on growth zone, infrastructure timeline, and exit value, not speculation.
about.pillar3Desc: Your file stays open with us. Resale advice, paperwork, swaps — the same WhatsApp number, ten years from now.

timeline.2008Desc: AlResalah is founded in Cairo with a single rule: only sell land we'd buy ourselves.
timeline.2014Desc: We open our industrial-land division, helping Egyptian factories pick locations with utilities and master plans approved.
timeline.2020Desc: We bet early on New Obour City (formerly El-Qadissia) — long before the highways made it obvious.
timeline.2026Desc: Premium residential and Suave Resort in development. The Cairo office on Gesr El-Suez stays your single point of contact.

services.title: Five things you only get with AlResalah
services.subtitle: We're a property developer, but most of our clients describe us as their land advisor first. Here is exactly what that means in practice.

trust.title: Plain-Arabic contracts
trust.desc: No legal traps. Every price, payment date and obligation is written in language you would read out loud at the dinner table.

location.title: We walk the plot with you
location.desc: We do not sell anything from a brochure. Our team meets you on the land itself — in New Obour, an industrial zone or the resort site — before a single pound is paid.
location.fact: Free site visit, even on Fridays.

value.title: Pricing built for resale
value.desc: We benchmark every plot against three reference deals from the same zone in the last 12 months. You see the math before you sign.

diverse.title: Investment, industrial, residential, resort
diverse.desc: Whether you are buying your first land in New Obour, scaling a factory, or moving into Suave Resort — it is the same team and the same standards across the portfolio.

support.title: We stay your number
support.desc: Delivery is not the end of the file. Resale support, paperwork, contractor referrals — the same advisor stays with you long after handover.
support.fact: Reach us 7 days a week on WhatsApp.

services.promise: If we cannot answer your question within 24 hours, we will tell you why on the first call.

cta.title: The land is still in your hands — at today's price
cta.subtitle: Tomorrow you will look for it and not find it at the same number. Book a 20-minute consultation with one of our advisors and walk away with a clear answer — even if AlResalah is not the right fit for you.
